index.card_testfile_desc: Generate a file of any size and extension: 100 KB PDF, 5 MB JPG, 20 MB BIN, 500 KB ZIP, for testing upload limits, dummy logins, or QA.

test-file-generator.title: Test File Generator: PDF, ZIP, JPG, PNG & More | norito
test-file-generator.meta_description: Generate a test file of any exact size and extension: PDF, ZIP, JPG, PNG, GIF, TXT, or BIN. Free, runs entirely in your browser, no upload needed.
test-file-generator.lede: Need a 5 MB JPG or a 100 KB PDF to test an upload limit? Pick a size and extension and download it instantly, generated locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded anywhere.
test-file-generator.panel_what_you_get_sub: Real, valid files, not just correctly-named junk.
test-file-generator.fmt_pdfzipgif_desc: Structurally valid. Open in any PDF viewer, unzip cleanly, or render as a real GIF, padded to your exact target size.
test-file-generator.fmt_jpgpng_desc: A real tiny image, padded to size using standard comment/chunk mechanisms every image viewer already knows to skip.
test-file-generator.fmt_txtbin_desc: Readable filler text, random bytes, or all-zero: your choice, exact byte count.
test-file-generator.note_below: Everything above ~a few hundred bytes hits your exact target size. A handful of formats (PDF, GIF, JPG, PNG, ZIP) have a small unavoidable structural minimum. The tool always shows you the real generated size, not just what you asked for.

compress-image.title: Compress Image to Exact Size (100KB, 200KB, 1MB...) | norito
compress-image.meta_description: Compress an image to a target file size, like 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, or 1MB, instead of fiddling with a quality slider. Runs entirely in your browser.
compress-image.h1: Compress Image to a Target Size
compress-image.lede: Skip the quality slider guesswork. Tell it the size you need, say 100 KB, and it finds the highest quality that fits, keeping your image's original width and height by default.
compress-image.dropzone_rest: , drag and drop it here, or paste with Ctrl+V
compress-image.dropzone_note: JPG, PNG, WebP. Stays on your device, nothing is uploaded.
compress-image.opt_allow_resize_hint: Off by default. Keeps the original width and height. Turn on to shrink dimensions too, for smaller targets quality alone can't reach.
compress-image.preview_hint: Your compressed image will appear here once generated.
compress-image.explainer: For JPEG/WebP, it binary-searches quality at your image's original size. If "Allow resizing" is off and quality alone can't hit the target, you'll get the smallest size possible without changing dimensions. PNG is lossless, so hitting a small target needs resizing turned on. JPEG or WebP will get you much closer to a small target at full size.

placeholder-generator.title: Placeholder Image Generator: Any Size, Color, Text | norito
placeholder-generator.meta_description: Generate a placeholder image with a custom size, background color, and label text. Free, instant, downloadable, runs in your browser.
placeholder-generator.lede: Pick dimensions, colors, and a label. Get an instant placeholder image for mockups, hero banners, or dev testing. No account, no watermark.

password-generator.title: Password Generator: Strong Passwords & Passphrases | norito
password-generator.meta_description: Generate a strong random password or memorable passphrase, with a live strength meter and character set controls. Runs entirely in your browser.
password-generator.lede: Random passwords or memorable passphrases, generated with your browser's cryptographic random number generator. Never sent anywhere, regenerates live as you tune the options.
password-generator.panel_strength_sub: Based on real entropy, not a guess.
password-generator.strength_explainer: Entropy is calculated from the actual pool size and length: character passwords use length × log2(pool size), passphrases use words × log2(word list size). Under 40 bits is crackable quickly offline; 60+ bits is solid for most accounts; 90+ is overkill in a good way.
password-generator.passphrase_explainer: A random string like xK9#mQ2p is hard to remember but not necessarily stronger than coral-lantern-otter-42, and the second one you can actually type without looking. The word list here has ~390 words, so more words closes the entropy gap with true random characters.

seo-slug-generator.meta_description: Turn a title into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug live as you type. Separator, casing, stopword removal, and batch mode for multiple titles at once.
seo-slug-generator.lede: Paste a title, get a clean URL slug back live as you type. Accents stripped, stopwords trimmed, separators your way. Switch to batch mode to slug a whole list of titles at once.
seo-slug-generator.placeholder_title_input: e.g. The Best Way to Learn JavaScript in 2026!
seo-slug-generator.value_title_input: The Best Way to Learn JavaScript in 2026!
seo-slug-generator.placeholder_batch_input:
One title per line

A third one

seo-slug-generator.batch_empty_hint: Paste titles above, one per line.
seo-slug-generator.panel_options_sub: Applies to both single and batch mode.
seo-slug-generator.explainer: Google doesn't need stopwords removed to rank a page, but shorter slugs are easier to read and share. 60 characters is a safe default that keeps most slugs on one line in search results.

limited-text-generator.placeholder_generated_text: Click Generate to create placeholder text.

qr-code-generator.title: QR Code Generator: Custom Colors & Logo, Free | norito
qr-code-generator.meta_description: Turn any link or text into a QR code live as you type. Pick colors, error correction level, add a center logo, export as PNG or SVG. Runs in your browser.
qr-code-generator.lede: Type a URL or any text and the QR code updates live. Custom colors, error correction level, an optional center logo, and export as PNG or SVG.
qr-code-generator.ec_hint: Keeps the QR code scannable even if part of it is damaged or covered. Higher % is safer but denser.
qr-code-generator.opt_logo_hint: Use error correction H for best scannability. Drag an image here or upload

remove-background.title: Remove Background from a Photo: Free, In-Browser | norito
remove-background.meta_description: Remove the background from a photo of a person, right in your browser. No upload to a server, transparent PNG or solid color export.
remove-background.lede: Cut a person out of a photo, entirely in your browser. The image never leaves your device. Built on a lightweight open-source segmentation model, so it works best when a person is clearly the main subject.
remove-background.heads_up_body: this uses MODNet, a portrait-matting model tuned for people, not general objects or products. Portraits and selfies work best. The model and the WebAssembly runtime it needs are about 18 MB combined and download once per browser session, then stay cached.
remove-background.dropzone_rest: , drag and drop it here, or paste with Ctrl+V
remove-background.dropzone_note: Works best with one person, clearly in frame.
remove-background.preview_hint: Your cutout will appear here once processed.
